passages.title: 搬家後的新朋友
passages.text: Last summer, my family {1} from Taipei to Tainan because of my dad's new job. I missed my old friends, and I {2} lonely in the new house. On the first day, a girl named Amy knocked on our door with a box of cookies. She lives next door with her grandparents and a big brown dog. She was very {3} to me. She showed me around the neighborhood and took me to a night market. I {4} the food there so much! Amy also taught me some Taiwanese words. Now we walk to school together every morning. I {5} help her with her English homework. Moving was hard at first, but I found a new best friend. Sometimes good things come when we least expect them.

blanks.why: move from A to B「從 A 搬到 B」：我們家從台北搬到台南。saved、paid、enjoyed 都不能接 from … to … 表示搬家。
feel + 形容詞「感到…」：felt lonely 覺得寂寞。planned、reported、saved 後面都不能直接接形容詞 lonely。
be kind to + 人「對某人很好」。likely 要接 to + 原形動詞，popular 要說 popular with + 人，free 是「免費的、有空的」，放在這裡都不通。
enjoy + 名詞「喜歡、享受」：我好喜歡那裡的食物。reported、became、decided the food 意思都不通。
even「甚至」：我甚至還幫她寫英文作業。ago 要放在一段時間後面，away 是「離開」，yet 用在否定句或問句，都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，因為爸爸換了新工作，我們家從台北搬到台南。我很想念以前的朋友，在新家覺得很寂寞。第一天，一個叫 Amy 的女生拿著一盒餅乾來敲我們家的門。她和爺爺奶奶還有一隻棕色大狗住在隔壁。她對我非常好，帶我認識附近的環境，還帶我去逛夜市。我好喜歡那裡的食物！Amy 也教我一些台語。現在我們每天早上一起走路上學，我甚至還會幫她寫英文作業。搬家一開始很辛苦，但我交到了一個新的好朋友。有時候，好事總在意想不到的時候出現。

passages.title: 存錢買腳踏車
passages.text: Kevin wanted a new bike, but it cost 6,000 dollars. His parents said, "If you really want it, you need to {1} money for it." So Kevin made a {2}. Every week, he put half of his pocket money into a jar. He stopped buying drinks and snacks after school, and he sold his old comic books to his classmates. It was not easy. Sometimes he {3} like giving up when his friends ate fried chicken in front of him. After eight months, he finally had enough money. He went to the bike shop and {4} for the bike himself. Now he rides it to school every day. "This bike is special," he says. "I worked hard for it, so I {5} every ride."

blanks.why: save money「存錢」。become、feel、enjoy money 意思都不通。
make a plan「訂計畫」。kind 是「種類」，news、homework 都是不可數名詞，前面不能加 a，而且意思也不通。
feel like + V-ing「想要做…」：有時候他很想放棄。paid、saved、moved like giving up 都不通。
pay for + 物「付…的錢」：他自己付錢買了腳踏車。moved、enjoyed、became for the bike 都不通。
enjoy every ride「享受每一次騎車」。save、pay、report every ride 意思都不合理。

passages.zh: Kevin 想要一台新腳踏車，但要六千元。爸媽說：「如果你真的想要，就要自己存錢買。」於是 Kevin 訂了一個計畫：每個星期，他把一半的零用錢放進罐子裡，放學後也不再買飲料和零食，還把舊漫畫賣給同學。這並不容易，有時候朋友在他面前吃炸雞，他真想放棄。八個月後，他終於存夠了錢。他走進腳踏車店，自己付錢買下了腳踏車。現在他每天騎車上學。「這台腳踏車很特別，」他說，「是我努力換來的，所以每次騎都很享受。」

passages.title: 班長的旅行計畫
passages.text: Our class is going on a trip to Jiufen next month, and Ms. Chen asked Tina, our class leader, to {1} it. Tina was excited. She looked for information online and found the cheapest bus. She also chose a famous shop that sells taro balls. Every student only has to {2} 300 dollars for the bus and lunch. Then she {3} her plan to the class. Everyone liked it, but Leo asked, "What if it rains?" Tina did not {4} think about that! So she added a rainy-day plan: a tea house with a great view. "A good plan always needs a Plan B," Ms. Chen said with a smile. The whole class {5} lucky to have such a careful leader.

blanks.why: plan a trip「規劃旅行」：老師請班長規劃這次旅行。become it、feel it、mean it 放在這裡意思都不通。
pay + 金額「付…錢」：每人只要付三百元。feel、enjoy、report 300 dollars 都不合理。
report … to + 人「向某人報告…」：她向全班報告她的計畫。enjoyed、felt、became her plan to the class 都不通。
not even「連…都沒有」：Tina 連想都沒想過這件事。ago、away、than 都不能放在 did not 和動詞中間。
feel + 形容詞：felt lucky 覺得很幸運。paid、saved、moved lucky 都不通。

passages.zh: 我們班下個月要去九份校外教學，陳老師請班長 Tina 負責規劃。Tina 很興奮，她上網找資料，找到最便宜的巴士，還選了一家很有名的芋圓店。每個學生只要付三百元，就包含車資和午餐。接著她向全班報告她的計畫。大家都很喜歡，但 Leo 問：「如果下雨怎麼辦？」Tina 連想都沒想過這件事！於是她加了一個雨天備案：一間景色很棒的茶館。「好的計畫一定要有備案。」陳老師笑著說。全班都覺得很幸運，能有這麼細心的班長。

passages.title: 雨夜裡的小狗
passages.text: On a rainy evening, Sam heard a small sound under a car. It was a puppy! It was wet and shaking. Sam {1} sorry for it, so he took it home. His mom was not happy at first. "We cannot keep a dog in our small apartment," she said. But when she saw the puppy's eyes, she changed her mind. They dried it and gave it some warm milk. The next day, they took it to an animal doctor. The doctor said, "You {2} its life. It was very sick." Sam's mom {3} the doctor 1,000 dollars. Now the puppy, Lucky, is part of the family. Everyone says Sam is a {4} boy. Lucky {5} sleeps next to Sam's bed every night.

blanks.why: feel sorry for + 人／動物「覺得…很可憐」。paid、planned、enjoyed sorry 都不通。
save one's life「救了…的命」。moved、reported、enjoyed its life 意思都不對。
pay + 人 + 金額「付給某人…錢」：媽媽付給醫生一千元。felt、enjoyed、planned 都不能這樣用。
kind「善良的」：Sam 是個善良的男孩。right boy、last boy 意思不通；even 是「平的、甚至」，而且 a even 的冠詞也不對。
even「甚至」：Lucky 甚至每晚睡在 Sam 的床邊。ago、away、than 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。

passages.zh: 一個下雨的傍晚，Sam 聽到車子底下有微弱的聲音。是一隻小狗！牠全身濕透，不停發抖。Sam 覺得牠好可憐，就把牠帶回家。媽媽一開始不太高興：「我們的小公寓不能養狗。」但看到小狗的眼睛後，她改變了主意。他們把小狗擦乾，餵牠喝溫牛奶。隔天，他們帶牠去看獸醫。醫生說：「你們救了牠一命，牠病得很重。」媽媽付給醫生一千元。現在小狗 Lucky 成了家裡的一份子，大家都說 Sam 是個善良的男孩。Lucky 甚至每天晚上都睡在 Sam 的床邊。

passages.title: 第一次露營
passages.text: Last weekend, my class went camping in the mountains. I had never slept outside before, so it was a new {1} for me. We put up tents, cooked noodles, and sang songs around a fire. The stars were so bright that we could see the Milky Way. In the middle of the night, something {2} outside our tent! I woke up my friend Ken. We were so scared that we did not {3} breathe. Then Ken turned on his flashlight. It was only a small cat looking for food! We laughed and gave it some bread. The next morning, we watched the sunrise together. I {4} it so much. Now I want to {5} another camping trip with my family.

blanks.why: a new experience「新的體驗」。kind 是「種類」，news、money 是不可數名詞，前面不能加 a，意思也不通。
move「移動」：半夜有東西在帳篷外移動。paid、saved、enjoyed 後面都需要受詞，而且意思不通。
not even「連…都不」：我們嚇得連呼吸都不敢。ago、away、than 都不能放在 did not 和動詞中間。
enjoy it「很喜歡、很享受」：我非常享受看日出。decided、moved、paid it 意思都不通。
plan a trip「計畫一趟旅行」。feel、pay、become another trip 都不合理（付錢要說 pay for）。

passages.zh: 上週末，我們班去山上露營。我從來沒有在外面過夜過，所以這對我來說是全新的體驗。我們搭帳篷、煮麵，還圍著營火唱歌。星星好亮，我們甚至看得到銀河。半夜，有東西在我們的帳篷外面移動！我叫醒朋友 Ken，我們嚇得連大氣都不敢喘。後來 Ken 打開手電筒，原來只是一隻在找食物的小貓！我們笑了出來，還分了一些麵包給牠。隔天早上，我們一起看日出，我真的好享受。現在我想和家人再計畫一趟露營。

passages.title: 哈利的第一堂飛行課
passages.text: At Hogwarts, Harry had his first flying lesson. The teacher told the students to stand next to their brooms and shout, "Up!" Harry's broom {1} into his hand right away, but Neville's broom just lay on the ground. Then Neville {2} so nervous that he flew too high and fell. While the teacher took him away, Malfoy grabbed Neville's Remembrall and flew up into the sky. Harry chased him. It was his first time on a broom, but he flew like a bird. He {3} caught the ball before it hit the ground. Professor McGonagall saw everything. Harry thought she would {4} him, and he would have to leave school. But she smiled and made him the youngest Seeker in a hundred years. Flying was the best {5} of Harry's life.

blanks.why: move「移動」：掃帚立刻飛進他手裡 moved into his hand。paid、saved、planned 都不能表示東西自己移動。
feel + 形容詞：felt so nervous 覺得非常緊張。paid、planned、reported nervous 都不通。
even「甚至」：他甚至在球落地前接住了它。ago、away、than 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。
report + 人「告發、檢舉某人」：哈利以為她會告發他，害他被退學。enjoy、feel、save him 和後面「得離開學校」意思不合。
the best experience of one's life「一生中最棒的經驗」。kind、news、business 放在這裡都不合理。

gloss: 霍格華茲（《哈利波特》裡的魔法學校）
搜捕手（魁地奇球賽的位置）
passages.zh: 在霍格華茲，哈利上了他的第一堂飛行課。老師叫學生站在掃帚旁邊大喊：「起！」哈利的掃帚立刻飛進他手裡，奈威的掃帚卻一動也不動地躺在地上。接著奈威太緊張，飛得太高，摔了下來。老師帶他離開時，馬份搶走奈威的記憶球，飛上天空。哈利追了上去。這是他第一次騎掃帚，卻飛得像鳥一樣，甚至在球落地前接住了它。麥教授全都看到了。哈利以為她會告發他，害他得離開學校。沒想到她笑了，還讓他成為一百年來最年輕的搜捕手。飛行是哈利這輩子最棒的經驗。

passages.title: 蜘蛛人的休假日
passages.text: Peter Parker had a busy week. He {1} three people from a fire and caught two thieves. On Saturday morning, he {2} really tired, so he decided to take a day off. He {3} to sleep late, eat pizza, and watch movies. But at noon, his phone rang. A big dog was stuck on a bridge! Peter sighed. "Can't I {4} have one free day?" He put on his suit and swung to the bridge. The dog was very scared, so Peter talked to it in a soft and {5} voice. Slowly, it walked into his arms. Later, the owner wanted to give him money, but Peter said no. Helping others was his job — on weekends, too. Then he flew home to finish his pizza.

blanks.why: save + 人 + from + 危險「從…中救出某人」。paid、enjoyed、felt three people from a fire 都不通。
feel + 形容詞：felt really tired 覺得很累。planned、paid、moved tired 都不通。
plan to + 原形動詞「打算做…」：他打算睡晚一點、吃披薩、看電影。felt to、paid to、reported to sleep 都不對。
not even「連…都不能」：難道我連一天假都不能放嗎？ago、away、than 都不能放在 can't I 和動詞中間。
a kind voice「溫和友善的聲音」。likely voice、last voice、right voice 都不合理。

passages.zh: 彼得‧帕克這個星期很忙：他從火場救出三個人，還抓了兩個小偷。星期六早上，他覺得好累，決定放一天假。他打算睡晚一點、吃披薩、看電影。但到了中午，電話響了：一隻大狗被困在橋上！彼得嘆了口氣：「難道我連一天假都不能放嗎？」他穿上戰衣，盪到橋邊。那隻狗非常害怕，彼得就用溫柔友善的聲音跟牠說話。慢慢地，牠走進了他的懷裡。後來狗主人想給他錢，但彼得拒絕了。幫助別人就是他的工作——週末也一樣。然後他飛回家，把披薩吃完。

passages.title: 倉鼠逃跑記
passages.text: My hamster, Mochi, is small, but she is very smart. One night, she pushed open the door of her cage and ran away! In the morning, I could not find her anywhere. I looked under the bed, inside my shoes, and in the kitchen. I {1} terrible. My sister made a {2}: we put some sunflower seeds on the floor of every room. Then we turned off the lights and waited quietly on the sofa. At ten o'clock, something {3} behind the bookshelf. It was Mochi! She was eating the seeds happily. She did not {4} look scared. Losing a pet is a scary {5}, so now I check her cage door every night. Mochi, please don't do that again!

blanks.why: feel + 形容詞：felt terrible 覺得很糟。enjoyed、paid、saved terrible 都不通。
make a plan「想出計畫」。kind 是「種類」，news、homework 是不可數名詞，前面不能加 a。
move「移動」：書櫃後面有東西在動。paid、saved、enjoyed 後面都需要受詞，意思也不通。
not even「連…都不」：牠看起來一點都不害怕。ago、away、than 都不能放在 did not 和動詞中間。
a scary experience「可怕的經驗」。kind、right 放在這裡不合理，news 不可數不能加 a。

passages.zh: 我的倉鼠麻糬雖然很小，卻非常聰明。有一天晚上，牠推開籠子的門跑掉了！早上我到處都找不到牠，床底下、鞋子裡和廚房都找過了，心裡難過極了。姊姊想了一個計畫：我們在每個房間的地上放一些葵花子，然後關掉電燈，坐在沙發上靜靜地等。十點的時候，書櫃後面有東西在動。是麻糬！牠正開心地吃著葵花子，一點都不害怕。寵物走失是很可怕的經驗，所以現在我每天晚上都會檢查牠的籠子門。麻糬，拜託別再這樣了！

passages.title: 最後一球
passages.text: It was the last minute of the basketball game, and our team was one point behind. Coach Lee called a time-out. "I have a {1}," he said. "Jay, you take the last shot." Jay's hands were shaking. He {2} all eyes on him. When the ball came to him, he {3} quickly to the left and jumped. The ball flew through the air ... and went in! We won! Everyone screamed and ran onto the court. Some of us cried, and Coach Lee lifted Jay into the air. Jay did not {4} know what happened at first. The next day, a student from the school paper came to {5} on the game, and Jay's photo was on the front page.

blanks.why: have a plan「有個計畫」。kind、right 放在這裡不通，news 不可數不能加 a。
feel + 受詞「感覺到…」：他感覺到大家都盯著他看。paid、saved、planned all eyes 意思都不通。
move「移動」：他迅速往左移動後跳投。paid、saved、reported quickly to the left 都不合理。
not even「甚至沒有」：Jay 一開始甚至不知道發生了什麼事。ago、away、than 都不能放在 did not 和動詞中間。
report on + 事件「報導…」：校刊的同學來報導這場比賽。pay on、save on、enjoy on the game 都不對。

passages.zh: 籃球比賽只剩最後一分鐘，我們隊落後一分。李教練喊了暫停：「我有個計畫，Jay，最後一球你來投。」Jay 的手在發抖，他感覺到所有人的目光都在他身上。球傳到他手上時，他迅速往左移動，然後跳起來投籃。球飛過空中……進了！我們贏了！大家尖叫著衝進球場，有些人哭了，李教練還把 Jay 舉了起來。Jay 一開始甚至不知道發生了什麼事。隔天，校刊的同學來報導這場比賽，Jay 的照片還登上了頭版。

passages.title: 姊姊的第一份打工
passages.text: My sister Ivy is seventeen. This summer, she got a part-time job at a coffee shop. The {1} is not very high — only 190 dollars an hour. But she says the job gives her a lot of useful {2}. At first, she was slow and made many mistakes. She often forgot which drink was for which customer. One day, she dropped a cup of hot coffee on the floor. She {3} very bad, but the customer was very {4} about it and said, "Don't worry." Now Ivy can make ten drinks in five minutes, and she remembers the names of many regular customers. She is {5} her money for a trip to Japan next year. She wants to visit a famous coffee shop in Kyoto.

blanks.why: pay 當名詞是「薪水」：薪水不太高，一小時才 190 元。kind、plan、news 都不能說「不太高、一小時 190 元」。
a lot of experience「很多經驗」（experience 指經驗時不可數）。kind、plan 是可數名詞，a lot of 後要用複數；right 意思也不通。
feel + 形容詞：felt very bad 覺得很過意不去。paid、enjoyed、planned bad 都不通。
be kind about + 事「對…很寬容」：客人很體諒她。likely、popular、free about it 都不通。
save money「存錢」：她在存錢準備明年去日本。feeling、reporting、becoming her money 都不合理。

passages.zh: 我姊姊 Ivy 十七歲。今年夏天，她在一家咖啡店打工。薪水不太高，一小時只有 190 元，但她說這份工作讓她累積了很多有用的經驗。一開始她動作很慢，常常出錯，老是忘記哪杯飲料是哪位客人的。有一天，她把一杯熱咖啡打翻在地上，覺得很過意不去，但那位客人很體諒，還說：「別擔心。」現在 Ivy 五分鐘就能做好十杯飲料，還記得許多常客的名字。她正在存錢，準備明年去日本旅行，她想去京都一家有名的咖啡店看看。

passages.title: 夜市套圈圈
passages.text: Every Friday night, my brother and I go to the night market near our home. Our favorite game is ring toss. One night, a little boy was trying to win a big teddy bear. He threw ten rings, but none of them went in. He {1} so sad that he started to cry. His mother had no more coins. My brother wanted to help, so he {2} 100 dollars for ten more rings. He threw them carefully, one by one. With the last ring, he won the bear! He gave it to the boy right away. The boy's mother thanked him again and again. "You are so {3}," she said. On the way home, I asked my brother, "Why did you do that? You didn't {4} want the bear." He smiled. "Seeing that boy smile was enough. I {5} the game more than ever tonight."

blanks.why: feel + 形容詞：felt so sad that … 難過到哭了出來。paid、saved、planned sad 都不通。
pay + 金額 + for + 物「花…錢買…」：哥哥花一百元買了十個圈圈。felt、enjoyed、moved 100 dollars for … 都不通。
kind「好心的、善良的」：你人真好。likely、last 放在這裡不通，away 是副詞「離開」，也不能形容人。
not even「甚至不」：你根本不想要那隻熊。ago、away、than 都不能放在 didn't 和動詞中間。
enjoy the game「享受這個遊戲」。reported、saved、planned the game 和「看到男孩笑」的語意不合。

passages.zh: 每個星期五晚上，我和哥哥都會去家附近的夜市。我們最喜歡玩套圈圈。有一天晚上，一個小男孩想贏一隻大泰迪熊，他丟了十個圈圈，一個都沒套中，難過得哭了出來。他媽媽也沒有零錢了。哥哥想幫忙，就花一百元又買了十個圈圈。他一個一個仔細地丟，最後一個圈圈終於套中了那隻熊！他馬上把熊送給小男孩。男孩的媽媽不停地向他道謝：「你人真好。」回家的路上，我問哥哥：「你為什麼這樣做？你根本就不想要那隻熊啊。」他笑著說：「看到那個男孩笑就夠了。今晚的遊戲是我玩得最開心的一次。」

passages.title: Minecraft 城堡
passages.text: Leo and his cousin Max love playing Minecraft. Last week, they {1} to build the biggest castle in their world. Max drew a map, and Leo collected stones and wood. They worked on it every evening for five days. The castle had tall walls, a long bridge, and a garden full of flowers. But on Friday night, Leo forgot to {2} the game before he went to bed. Then there was a power cut, and the computer shut down. The next morning, half of the castle was gone! Leo {3} terrible. Max was angry at first, but then he said, "Let's build it again. This time it will be {4} better." And it was. The new castle had a dragon tower and a secret room under the lake. Leo learned an important lesson from this {5}, and now he never forgets to press the button.

blanks.why: plan to + 原形動詞「計畫要做…」：他們計畫蓋全世界最大的城堡。felt to、paid to、enjoyed to build 都不對。
save the game「存檔」：Leo 睡前忘了存檔。feel、pay、report the game 意思都不通。
feel + 形容詞：felt terrible 覺得很難過。paid、saved、moved terrible 都不通。
even + 比較級「甚至更…」：這次會蓋得更好 even better。ago、away、than 都不能放在比較級前面加強語氣。
learn a lesson from this experience「從這次經驗學到教訓」。kind、right、money 放在這裡都不合理。

passages.zh: Leo 和表哥 Max 很喜歡玩 Minecraft。上星期，他們計畫在遊戲世界裡蓋一座最大的城堡。Max 畫地圖，Leo 收集石頭和木材。連續五天，他們每天晚上都在蓋。城堡有高高的城牆、一座長橋，還有一座開滿花的花園。但星期五晚上，Leo 睡前忘了存檔。接著停電了，電腦關機。隔天早上，半座城堡都不見了！Leo 難過極了。Max 一開始很生氣，但後來說：「我們再蓋一次吧，這次會蓋得更好。」結果真的是這樣：新的城堡有一座龍塔，湖底下還有一間祕密房間。Leo 從這次經驗學到重要的教訓，現在他再也不會忘記按存檔鍵了。

passages.title: 外婆的菜園
passages.text: My grandma lives in the countryside in Yilan. Behind her house, there is a big vegetable garden. Every summer, I {1} staying with her for two weeks. Grandma gets up at five every morning to water the plants. She says vegetables are like children: "If you take good care of them, they will grow well." This year, she let me {2} my own small garden. I planted tomatoes and corn, and I checked them every day. When I saw the first little tomato, I {3} so proud. Grandma also taught me to {4} rainwater in big buckets. "Never waste water," she said. "The garden needs every drop." At the end of my stay, we cooked a big dinner with our own vegetables. It was the best meal I had ever had. Grandma's neighbors {5} came over to try my tomatoes.

blanks.why: enjoy + V-ing「喜歡做…」：我很喜歡去外婆家住兩個星期。save、pay、report staying 都不通。
plan a garden「規劃一塊菜園」。pay、feel、report my own small garden 意思都不通。
feel + 形容詞：felt so proud 覺得很驕傲。paid、saved、planned proud 都不通。
save rainwater「收集、儲存雨水」。feel、pay、report rainwater 意思都不通。
even「甚至」：鄰居甚至跑來吃我的番茄。ago、away、than 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。

passages.zh: 我的外婆住在宜蘭的鄉下，她家後面有一大片菜園。每年暑假，我都很喜歡去她家住兩個星期。外婆每天早上五點起床澆水。她說蔬菜就像小孩一樣：「好好照顧，它們就會長得好。」今年，她讓我規劃一小塊自己的菜園。我種了番茄和玉米，每天都去看。看到第一顆小番茄時，我覺得好驕傲。外婆也教我把雨水存在大水桶裡。「絕對不要浪費水，」她說，「菜園需要每一滴水。」住到最後一天，我們用自己種的菜煮了一頓大餐，那是我吃過最棒的一餐。外婆的鄰居甚至跑來嚐我種的番茄。

passages.title: 捷運上的座位
passages.text: Every day, Annie takes the MRT to school. One morning, the train was very crowded. Annie got a seat and started to read her notes for an English test. At the next station, an old man with a cane got on. Annie {1} tired, and she really wanted to study. But she stood up and said, "Please sit here." The old man smiled. "You are very {2}," he said. They started to talk. He was a retired English teacher! When he heard about her test, he helped her go over the new words. He {3} taught her a fun way to remember them. Annie {4} the ride so much that she almost missed her stop. That afternoon, she got 98 on the test. "Helping others can {5} off," she told her mom with a laugh.

blanks.why: feel + 形容詞：felt tired 覺得很累。paid、saved、enjoyed tired 都不通。
kind「好心的」：你真是好心。likely、last 放在這裡不通；free 是「免費的、有空的」，不能用來稱讚讓座的人。
even「甚至」：他甚至教她一個好玩的記憶方法。ago、away、than 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。
enjoy the ride「很享受這趟車程」。reported、saved、paid the ride 和「差點坐過站」的語意不合。
pay off「有回報、值得」：幫助別人是會有回報的。report off、save off、plan off 都不是片語。

passages.zh: Annie 每天搭捷運上學。有一天早上，車廂非常擠。Annie 搶到一個座位，開始看英文考試的筆記。到了下一站，一位拄著拐杖的老先生上車了。Annie 覺得很累，也很想念書，但她還是站起來說：「請坐這裡。」老先生笑著說：「你真是好心。」他們聊了起來，原來他是一位退休的英文老師！知道她要考試後，他幫她複習新單字，甚至還教她一個好玩的記憶方法。Annie 這趟車坐得太開心，差點坐過站。那天下午，她考了 98 分。「幫助別人是會有回報的。」她笑著跟媽媽說。

passages.title: 太空營的五天
passages.text: This summer, Ryan went to a space camp for five days. It was an {1} he will never forget. On the first day, the students wore heavy space suits and walked in a special room. Everything {2} so strange! It was like walking on the moon. On the second day, they sat in a machine that turned around and around. Some students got sick, but Ryan loved it. Then each team had to {3} a trip to Mars. They needed to decide how much food, water, and air to take. On the last day, every team gave a {4} about their trip to the teachers and parents. The teachers said Ryan's team had the best idea. Ryan {5} got a small rocket as a prize. Now he reads about space every night and dreams of becoming an astronaut.

blanks.why: an experience「一次經驗」：這是他永遠忘不了的經驗。前面是 an，kind、news、plan 都不能接 an，news 也不可數。
feel + 形容詞「感覺起來…」：一切感覺都好奇怪。paid、saved、planned strange 都不通。
plan a trip「規劃一趟旅程」：每隊要規劃一趟火星之旅。feel、become、pay a trip 都不通。
give a report「做報告」：每隊向老師和家長報告。kind 不通，news、money 是不可數名詞，不能加 a。
even「甚至」：Ryan 甚至得到一個小火箭當獎品。ago、away、than 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。

passages.zh: 今年夏天，Ryan 參加了為期五天的太空營，那是他永遠忘不了的經驗。第一天，學員穿上厚重的太空衣，在一個特別的房間裡走路，一切感覺都好奇怪，就像在月球上走路一樣！第二天，他們坐進一台不停旋轉的機器，有些學員暈了，但 Ryan 超愛。接著每一隊要規劃一趟火星之旅，決定要帶多少食物、水和空氣。最後一天，每一隊都要向老師和家長報告他們的旅程。老師們說 Ryan 這隊的點子最好，Ryan 甚至還得到一個小火箭當獎品。現在他每天晚上都看和太空有關的書，夢想成為太空人。

passages.title: 舅舅的單車環島
passages.text: Last winter, my uncle {1} to ride his bike around Taiwan. He wanted to finish the trip in ten days. Every day, he rode about 100 kilometers. On the third day, it rained all day, and his legs {2} like stone. He wanted to give up and take the train home. But people along the way were very {3} to him. A woman at a 7-Eleven gave him hot soup and didn't let him {4} for it. A family in Taitung invited him to stay at their house for a night. With their help, he kept going. After ten days, he finally got home. He said the best part of the trip was not the beautiful sea or the mountains. It was the people. "I {5} every moment," he told us, "even the rainy ones."

blanks.why: plan to + 原形動詞「計畫做…」：舅舅計畫騎單車環島。felt to、paid to、enjoyed to ride 都不對。
feel like + 名詞「感覺像…」：他的腿重得像石頭一樣。paid、saved、planned like stone 都不通。
be kind to + 人「對某人很好」。likely、last、even to him 都不通。
pay for + 物「付…的錢」：她不讓他付湯的錢。feel、enjoy、become for it 都不通。
enjoy every moment「享受每一刻」。paid、saved、moved every moment 意思都不通。

passages.zh: 去年冬天，我舅舅計畫騎腳踏車環島。他想在十天內完成，每天大約騎一百公里。第三天下了一整天的雨，他的腿重得像石頭一樣，好想放棄，搭火車回家。但一路上的人都對他很好：一位 7-Eleven 的店員請他喝熱湯，不讓他付錢；台東的一戶人家還邀他到家裡住一晚。有了大家的幫忙，他繼續騎下去。十天後，他終於回到家。他說這趟旅行最棒的不是美麗的大海或高山，而是人。「每一刻我都很享受，」他告訴我們，「連下雨的那幾天也是。」

passages.title: 胡迪的搬家日
passages.text: Andy's family was going to {1} to a new house. The toys in his room were worried. "What if Andy leaves us behind?" asked Rex. Woody {2} nervous too, but he did not show it. Instead, he made a {3}: every toy had to jump into the big box when Andy was not looking. Buzz helped the small toys climb in first. But at the last moment, Rex was too big to fit! Woody pulled, Buzz pushed, and the box almost fell over. Finally, Rex was in, and they closed the box just before Andy came back. When Andy opened the box in his new room, he was surprised. "How did you all get here?" He did not {4} remember packing them. The toys smiled quietly. For them, it was an exciting {5}, and they did it together.

blanks.why: move to + 地方「搬到…」：Andy 家要搬到新房子。save、pay、enjoy to a new house 都不通。
feel + 形容詞：felt nervous 覺得緊張。paid、saved、planned nervous 都不通。
make a plan「想出計畫」。kind、right 放在這裡不通，news 不可數不能加 a。
not even「甚至不…」：他根本不記得自己有把它們打包。ago、away、than 都不能放在 did not 和動詞中間。
an exciting experience「刺激的經驗」。kind、right 意思不通，news 不可數，也不能接 an。

gloss: 抱抱龍（《玩具總動員》的角色）
passages.zh: Andy 家要搬到新房子了，房間裡的玩具都很擔心。「萬一 Andy 把我們丟下怎麼辦？」抱抱龍問。胡迪也很緊張，但他沒有表現出來，反而想了一個計畫：趁 Andy 不注意時，每個玩具都要跳進大箱子裡。巴斯光年先幫小玩具爬進去。但到了最後一刻，抱抱龍太大了，塞不進去！胡迪拉、巴斯推，箱子差點翻倒。抱抱龍終於進去了，他們在 Andy 回來前把箱子關好。Andy 在新房間打開箱子時嚇了一跳：「你們怎麼都在這裡？」他根本不記得自己有把它們打包。玩具們偷偷地笑了。對它們來說，這是一次刺激的經驗，而且是大家一起完成的。

passages.title: 艾莎的冰淇淋店
passages.text: In a small town, Elsa decided to open an ice cream shop. With her magic, she could make ice cream in just a few seconds. On the first day, many children came. They {1} her snowflake ice cream so much! Anna helped her at the counter. Each cone was only 30 dollars, so all the kids in town could {2} for one. But one hot afternoon, Elsa {3} sick, and her magic stopped working. All the ice cream started to melt! Anna had an idea. She asked Olaf to stand in front of the shop and tell jokes. While people were laughing, Kristoff brought big blocks of ice down from the mountains. Together they {4} the shop that day. Elsa hugged her sister. "Thank you, Anna. You are the {5} of sister everyone wants."

blanks.why: enjoy + 名詞「很喜歡」：孩子們好喜歡她的雪花冰淇淋。paid、saved、moved her ice cream 都不通（付錢要說 pay for）。
pay for + 物：每支才三十元，鎮上的孩子都買得起。feel、enjoy、report for one 都不通。
feel + 形容詞：felt sick 覺得不舒服。paid、saved、planned sick 都不通。
save the shop「拯救了這家店」。felt、reported、became the shop 意思都不通。
the kind of + 名詞「那種…」：你就是大家都想要的那種姊妹。news、business、plan of sister 都不通。

gloss: 雪寶（《冰雪奇緣》裡的雪人）
passages.zh: 在一個小鎮上，艾莎決定開一家冰淇淋店。她有魔法，幾秒鐘就能做出冰淇淋。開幕第一天來了好多孩子，他們好喜歡她的雪花冰淇淋！安娜在櫃檯幫忙。每支甜筒只要三十元，鎮上所有孩子都買得起。但一個炎熱的下午，艾莎覺得身體不舒服，魔法失靈了，所有冰淇淋都開始融化！安娜想到一個辦法：她請雪寶站在店門口講笑話。大家笑成一團的時候，阿克從山上搬來一大塊一大塊的冰。那天，他們一起拯救了這家店。艾莎抱住妹妹：「謝謝你，安娜。你就是大家都想要的那種姊妹。」

passages.title: 紅包怎麼花
passages.text: After Chinese New Year, Jenny got 8,000 dollars in red envelopes. She wanted to buy a new video game right away. But her dad said, "Why don't you make a {1} first?" So Jenny sat down and thought about it carefully. She decided to {2} half of the money in the bank. With 2,000 dollars, she bought a birthday present for her mom: a soft scarf. Then she {3} for a cooking class with the rest. At the class, she learned to make dumplings and green onion pancakes. She {4} it more than any video game. When her mom opened the present, she was very happy. "You didn't {5} buy anything for yourself," she said. Jenny smiled. "The cooking class was for me. And now I can cook for all of us!"

blanks.why: make a plan「先做個計畫」。kind 不通，news、homework 是不可數名詞，不能加 a。
save money in the bank「把錢存進銀行」。feel、report、become half of the money 都不通。
pay for + 物：她用剩下的錢報名了烹飪課。felt、enjoyed、moved for a cooking class 都不通。
enjoy it「很喜歡」：她喜歡烹飪課勝過任何電玩。paid、saved、reported it more than any video game 都不通。
not even「連…都沒有」：你連一樣東西都沒買給自己。ago、away、than 都不能放在 didn't 和動詞中間。

passages.zh: 過完年，Jenny 拿到八千元紅包。她想馬上去買一款新電玩，但爸爸說：「要不要先做個計畫？」於是 Jenny 坐下來好好想了想。她決定把一半的錢存進銀行，用兩千元買了一條柔軟的圍巾當作媽媽的生日禮物，剩下的錢則拿去報名烹飪課。在課堂上，她學會了包餃子和做蔥油餅，比玩任何電玩都開心。媽媽打開禮物時非常高興：「你連一樣東西都沒買給自己。」Jenny 笑著說：「烹飪課就是給我自己的呀，而且現在我可以煮給大家吃了！」

passages.title: 圖書館的罰款
passages.text: Tom borrowed three books from the city library. He was supposed to return them in two weeks, but he forgot. One month later, he got a message from the library: he had to {1} a fine of 90 dollars. Tom {2} terrible. He did not want to tell his mom, so he looked everywhere for the books. Finally, he found them under his bed. They were dusty but okay. He went to the library and told the librarian, "I am sorry. I am late because I lost them." The librarian smiled. "Thank you for telling me the truth." She {3} showed him an app that sends a reminder before the due date. Tom {4} the fine with his own pocket money. This {5} taught him to be more careful, and now he always returns his books on time.

blanks.why: pay a fine「繳罰款」。feel、enjoy、save a fine 意思都不通。
feel + 形容詞：felt terrible 覺得很糟。paid、planned、reported terrible 都不通。
even「甚至」：她甚至介紹他一個會提醒還書的 app。ago、away、than 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。
pay the fine「繳了罰款」。felt、enjoyed、became the fine 都不通。
This experience taught him …「這次經驗教會他…」。kind、right、money 當主詞都不合理。

passages.zh: Tom 從市立圖書館借了三本書，本來應該兩個星期內歸還，但他忘了。一個月後，他收到圖書館的訊息：他得繳九十元罰款。Tom 覺得很糟，他不想告訴媽媽，於是到處找那幾本書，最後在床底下找到了。書上積了灰塵，但沒有損壞。他到圖書館跟館員說：「對不起，我遲還是因為我把書弄丟了。」館員笑著說：「謝謝你說實話。」她甚至介紹他一個會在到期日前提醒的 app。Tom 用自己的零用錢繳了罰款。這次經驗讓他學會更小心，現在他總是準時還書。

passages.title: 跌倒也要跑完
passages.text: Our class was in the relay race on Sports Day. Before the race, our PE teacher helped us {1} the order of the runners. Wendy is the fastest, so she ran last. I was the third runner. When I got the baton, I {2} my heart beating fast. I ran as hard as I could, but near the corner, I fell down! My knees hurt, and our team {3} from first place to fourth. I got up and kept running with tears in my eyes. Then Wendy took the baton. She passed one runner, then two, then three! We won! After the race, I said sorry to everyone, but they were very {4}. "You got up and finished. That is what matters," Wendy said. It was the best Sports Day {5} I have ever had.

blanks.why: plan the order「安排順序」：老師幫我們安排跑者的棒次。pay、feel、save the order 都不通。
feel + 受詞 + V-ing「感覺到…正在…」：我感覺到心跳得好快。paid、planned、saved my heart beating 都不通。
move from A to B「從 A 變到 B」：我們隊從第一名掉到第四名。paid、saved、enjoyed from first place to fourth 都不通。
kind「體貼的、好心的」：大家都很體諒我。likely、last 放在這裡不通，away 是副詞「離開」，不能形容人。
the best experience「最棒的經驗」。kind、right、money 放在這裡都不合理。

passages.zh: 運動會那天，我們班參加大隊接力。比賽前，體育老師幫我們安排跑者的棒次。Wendy 跑最快，所以她跑最後一棒，我是第三棒。拿到接力棒時，我感覺到自己心跳好快。我拚命地跑，卻在彎道附近跌倒了！我的膝蓋好痛，我們隊也從第一名掉到第四名。我爬起來，含著眼淚繼續跑。接著 Wendy 接過棒子，她超過一個、兩個、三個人！我們贏了！比賽結束後，我向大家道歉，但大家都很體諒我。「你爬起來跑完了，這才是最重要的。」Wendy 說。這是我參加過最棒的一次運動會。

passages.title: 便利商店的一天
passages.text: For a school project, Nina {1} life as a store clerk for one day. Her aunt owns a convenience store near the train station, so Nina worked there on Saturday. In the morning, she {2} heavy boxes of drinks into the fridge. She also learned how to make coffee and heat up lunch boxes. By noon, her arms {3} so tired. Then an old woman came in. She wanted to send a package, but she did not know how to use the machine. Nina helped her step by step. The woman held Nina's hand and said, "What a {4} girl!" At the end of the day, Nina wrote a {5} for her project. Her title was "A Clerk's Job Is Not Easy." Now she always says thank you to the clerks when she buys something.

blanks.why: experience 當動詞「體驗」：Nina 體驗了一天店員的生活。paid、saved、moved life as a store clerk 都不通。
move + 物 + into + 地方「把…搬進…」：她把一箱箱飲料搬進冰箱。felt、paid、enjoyed heavy boxes 都不通。
feel + 形容詞：her arms felt tired 她的手臂好痠。paid、saved、planned tired 都不通。
What a kind girl!「真是好心的女孩！」right、last 不能這樣稱讚人，away 是副詞，不能放在 a 和名詞中間。
write a report「寫報告」。kind 不通，news、money 是不可數名詞，不能加 a。

passages.zh: 為了學校的專題，Nina 體驗了一天的店員生活。她阿姨在火車站附近開便利商店，所以她星期六去那裡工作。早上，她把一箱箱很重的飲料搬進冰箱，也學會煮咖啡和加熱便當。到了中午，她的手臂已經痠得不得了。後來一位老太太走進來，想寄包裹卻不會用機器，Nina 一步一步地幫她。老太太握著 Nina 的手說：「真是個好心的女孩！」一天結束時，Nina 為專題寫了一份報告，標題是〈店員的工作不簡單〉。現在她買東西時，總會跟店員說聲謝謝。

passages.title: 柯南與消失的蛋糕
passages.text: "Someone ate my cake!" shouted Ayumi. She had put a piece of strawberry cake in the classroom fridge, but now the box was empty. She {1} so angry that she wanted to {2} it to the teacher right away. Genta {3} to buy her a new one after school. But Conan said, "Wait. Let me look first." He found some white cream on the window. He also saw some small footprints on the desk. "The thief is not a person," he said. He opened the window and pointed at the tree outside. There was a fat cat on a branch, and it was licking cream from its mouth! Everyone laughed. The cat did not {4} look sorry. "Well," said Ayumi, "that cat has good taste. It {5} the best cake in town!"

blanks.why: feel + 形容詞：felt so angry that … 氣到想要…。paid、saved、planned angry 都不通。
report … to + 人「向某人報告…」：她想馬上報告老師。enjoy、feel、save it to the teacher 都不通。
plan to + 原形動詞「打算做…」：元太打算放學後買一塊新的給她。felt to、paid to、enjoyed to buy 都不對。
not even「連…都不」：那隻貓一點都沒有不好意思的樣子。ago、away、than 都不能放在 did not 和動詞中間。
enjoy + 食物「享用」：牠享用了鎮上最好吃的蛋糕。paid、moved、reported the best cake 意思都不通。

gloss: 步美（《名偵探柯南》的角色）
passages.zh: 「有人吃了我的蛋糕！」步美大喊。她把一塊草莓蛋糕放在教室的冰箱裡，現在盒子卻空了。她氣得想馬上去報告老師，元太則打算放學後買一塊新的給她。但柯南說：「等一下，讓我先看看。」他在窗戶上發現一些白色奶油，桌上還有幾個小小的腳印。「小偷不是人。」他說。他打開窗戶，指著外面的樹。樹枝上有一隻胖貓，正在舔嘴邊的奶油！大家都笑了，那隻貓一點都沒有不好意思的樣子。「好吧，」步美說，「那隻貓很有品味，牠享用了鎮上最好吃的蛋糕！」

passages.title: 怕水的 Mark
passages.text: Mark was afraid of water. When he was six, he fell into a pool, and he never forgot that {1}. This summer, his mom took him to swimming lessons. On the first day, he {2} so scared that he did not want to get in. His coach was patient. "Let's just put your feet in today," she said. The next day, Mark put his whole body in the water. Slowly, he learned to {3} his arms and legs the right way. He swallowed a lot of water, but he did not give up. After a month, he could swim 25 meters. His mom cried when she saw it. Now Mark {4} swimming more than any other sport. He {5} wants to join the school swimming team next year.

blanks.why: that experience「那次經驗」：他一直忘不了那次掉進泳池的經驗。kind、right、money 和「掉進泳池」的語意都不合。
feel + 形容詞：felt so scared that … 害怕到不想下水。paid、saved、planned scared 都不通。
move one's arms and legs「擺動手腳」。pay、save、plan his arms and legs 都不通。
enjoy + V-ing「喜歡做…」：他現在最喜歡游泳。pays、saves、reports swimming 都不通。
even「甚至」：他甚至想參加校隊。ago、away、than 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。

passages.zh: Mark 很怕水。六歲時他曾掉進游泳池，一直忘不了那次經驗。今年夏天，媽媽帶他去上游泳課。第一天，他害怕得不肯下水。教練很有耐心：「我們今天先把腳放進水裡就好。」隔天，Mark 整個人都下水了。慢慢地，他學會用正確的方式擺動手腳。他喝了很多水，但沒有放棄。一個月後，他能游二十五公尺了，媽媽看到時感動得哭了。現在 Mark 喜歡游泳勝過任何運動，他甚至想在明年參加學校的游泳隊。

passages.title: 演唱會的門票
passages.text: My favorite singer is coming to Taipei for a concert in December! A ticket costs 3,800 dollars, and my parents said I have to {1} for it myself. So I started to {2} money. I stopped buying bubble tea, and I walked my neighbor's dog every day after school. She {3} me 100 dollars a week. After four months, I finally had enough money. But on the day the tickets went on sale, the website was very slow. When I finally got in, all the tickets were gone! I {4} like crying. Then my best friend called. "My sister can't go to the concert. Do you want her ticket?" I could not believe my luck! At the concert, I sang and danced all night. I {5} every song. It was worth every dollar and every walk with the dog.

blanks.why: pay for + 物「付…的錢」：爸媽說我得自己付票錢。feel、enjoy、become for it 都不通。
save money「存錢」。feel、report、become money 意思都不通。
pay + 人 + 金額「付給某人…錢」：鄰居每週付我一百元。felt、enjoyed、planned me 100 dollars 都不通。
feel like + V-ing「想要…」：我好想哭。paid、saved、planned like crying 都不通。
enjoy every song「享受每一首歌」。paid、saved、reported every song 意思都不通。

passages.zh: 我最喜歡的歌手十二月要來台北開演唱會！一張票三千八百元，爸媽說我得自己付錢。於是我開始存錢：我不再買珍珠奶茶，每天放學後幫鄰居遛狗，她每星期付我一百元。四個月後，我終於存夠了錢。但開賣那天，網站好慢，等我終於進去，票已經全部賣光了！我難過得好想哭。這時我最好的朋友打電話來：「我姊姊不能去演唱會了，你要她的票嗎？」我簡直不敢相信自己這麼幸運！演唱會上，我整晚又唱又跳，每一首歌都好享受。每一塊錢、每一次遛狗都值得了。

passages.title: 我家的機器狗
passages.text: For my birthday, my uncle gave me a robot dog named Bolt. He is not a real dog, but he can {1} like one. He walks, sits, and shakes hands. When I come home, he wags his tail. When I am sad, he puts his head on my leg. It {2} like he understands me. Bolt can also {3} the weather every morning: "Today will be sunny. Don't forget your hat!" But Bolt is not perfect. One day, he walked into the fish tank and broke his leg. I had to {4} 2,000 dollars to fix him. My friends often ask me, "Is a robot dog better than a real one?" I think they are different {5} of friends. Bolt can't eat or run in the park, but he is still my best friend.

blanks.why: move「移動、活動」：牠能像真的狗一樣活動。pay、save、plan like one 都不通。
It feels like …「感覺好像…」：感覺好像牠懂我。pays、saves、plans like 都不通。
report the weather「報告天氣」：牠每天早上報天氣。become、save、pay the weather 都不通。
pay + 金額 + to + 原形動詞「付…錢來做…」：我得花兩千元修牠。feel、enjoy、become 2,000 dollars 都不通。
different kinds of …「不同種類的…」。news、weather、money 都是不可數名詞，不會說 different news of friends，意思也不通。

passages.zh: 我生日的時候，叔叔送我一隻叫 Bolt 的機器狗。牠不是真的狗，卻能像真狗一樣活動：牠會走路、坐下、握手。我回家時，牠會搖尾巴；我難過時，牠會把頭靠在我腿上，感覺好像牠懂我。Bolt 每天早上還會報天氣：「今天是晴天，別忘了帶帽子！」但 Bolt 不是完美的。有一天，牠走進魚缸，把腿弄壞了，我得花兩千元修牠。朋友常問我：「機器狗比真的狗好嗎？」我覺得牠們是不同種類的朋友。Bolt 不能吃東西，也不能在公園裡跑，但牠還是我最好的朋友。

passages.title: 去海邊撿垃圾
passages.text: Last Saturday, our class went to a beach in Keelung. We did not go there to swim. We went to clean it! When we got there, I could not believe my eyes. There were bottles, plastic bags, and old shoes everywhere. I {1} sad for the fish and sea turtles. We worked in groups of four. In two hours, we {2} more than fifty bags of trash to the truck. It was hot, and my back hurt, but nobody stopped. When we finished, the beach looked clean and beautiful. Our teacher said, "You {3} this beach today." It was hard work, but it was a great {4} for all of us. Now I {5} bring my own bag and bottle when I go out, so I make less trash.

blanks.why: feel sad for + 名詞「為…感到難過」。paid、saved、planned sad 都不通。
move + 物 + to + 地方「把…搬到…」：我們把五十多袋垃圾搬上卡車。felt、paid、enjoyed fifty bags of trash 都不通。
save the beach「拯救了海灘」。felt、paid、reported this beach 意思都不通。
a great experience「很棒的經驗」。kind、right 不通，news 不可數不能加 a。
even「甚至」：我現在甚至會自備購物袋和水瓶。ago、away、than 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。

passages.zh: 上星期六，我們班去基隆的一處海灘。我們不是去游泳，而是去打掃！一到那裡，我簡直不敢相信自己的眼睛：到處都是瓶子、塑膠袋和舊鞋子。我替魚和海龜感到難過。我們四人一組，兩個小時內就把五十多袋垃圾搬上卡車。天氣很熱，我的背也很痠，但沒有人停下來。結束時，海灘看起來乾淨又美麗。老師說：「你們今天拯救了這片海灘。」雖然很辛苦，但對我們每個人來說都是很棒的經驗。現在我出門甚至會自己帶袋子和水瓶，少製造一點垃圾。

passages.title: 英文課的氣象報告
passages.text: In English class, Ms. Wang asked each of us to give a weather {1} in front of the class. My turn was on Monday. I {2} to wear my dad's suit, just like a real TV weatherman. I practiced many times at home. But when I stood in front of the class, my mind went blank. I could not remember a single word! I {3} my face turn red. Then I saw my friend Joe in the back. He was holding up a piece of paper. It said, "SUNNY, 28 DEGREES." He {4} me! I finished my report, and everyone clapped. Ms. Wang smiled and said, "{5} real weathermen forget their words sometimes." After class, I bought Joe a cup of bubble tea to say thank you.

blanks.why: give a weather report「做氣象報告」。kind、plan 放在這裡不通，news 不可數不能加 a。
plan to + 原形動詞「打算做…」：我打算穿爸爸的西裝。felt to、paid to、enjoyed to wear 都不對。
feel + 受詞 + 原形動詞「感覺到…」：我感覺到自己臉紅了。paid、saved、planned my face turn red 都不通。
save + 人「救了某人」：他救了我！felt、enjoyed、planned me 意思都不通。
even「甚至、連…都」：連真正的氣象主播有時也會忘詞。Ago、Away、Than 都不能放在句首修飾名詞。

passages.zh: 英文課上，王老師要我們每個人在全班面前做一段氣象報告。輪到我的那天是星期一。我打算穿爸爸的西裝，就像真正的電視氣象主播一樣。我在家練習了很多次，但當我站在全班面前時，腦袋突然一片空白，一個字都想不起來！我感覺到自己的臉都紅了。這時我看到坐在後面的好朋友 Joe，他舉著一張紙，上面寫著「晴天，28 度」。他救了我！我順利完成報告，大家都拍手。王老師笑著說：「連真正的氣象主播有時也會忘詞。」下課後，我請 Joe 喝一杯珍珠奶茶謝謝他。

passages.title: 年前大掃除
passages.text: Every year before Chinese New Year, our class has a big cleaning day. This year, our teacher wanted us to {1} all the desks to the back of the room so we could wash the floor. The desks were heavy, so we worked in pairs. While I was pushing my desk, a lot of old things fell out: three pencils, a lost math test, and a very old sandwich! Everyone laughed, and I {2} so embarrassed. Then my classmate Ben found a 100-dollar bill under his desk. He did not keep it. He {3} it to the teacher. "Ben is an honest boy," she said. "We should all learn from him." By the end of the day, the classroom looked like new. It was hard work, but we {4} it because we did it together. Our teacher {5} bought us bubble tea.

blanks.why: move + 物 + to + 地方「把…移到…」：老師要我們把桌子搬到教室後面。pay、save、enjoy all the desks 都不通。
feel + 形容詞：felt embarrassed 覺得很丟臉。paid、planned、saved embarrassed 都不通。
report … to + 人「把…報告給某人」：他把錢交給老師處理。enjoyed、felt、became it to the teacher 都不通。
enjoy it「樂在其中」：雖然辛苦，但我們很開心。paid、saved、reported it 和「因為大家一起做」語意不合。
even「甚至」：老師甚至請我們喝珍奶。ago、away、than 都不能放在主詞和動詞中間。

passages.zh: 每年過年前，我們班都會大掃除。今年，老師要我們把所有桌子搬到教室後面，好把地板刷乾淨。桌子很重，所以我們兩人一組。我推桌子的時候，掉出一大堆舊東西：三枝鉛筆、一張不見很久的數學考卷，還有一個超級舊的三明治！大家都笑了，我覺得好丟臉。接著同學 Ben 在他桌子底下撿到一張一百元鈔票，他沒有據為己有，而是交給老師。「Ben 是個誠實的孩子，」老師說，「我們都應該向他學習。」到了傍晚，教室煥然一新。雖然很辛苦，但因為是大家一起做的，我們都很開心。老師甚至還請我們喝珍珠奶茶。

passages.title: 魯夫偷吃便當
passages.text: Luffy loves meat more than anything. One day, Sanji made a big lunch box for everyone on the ship. Luffy finished his in one minute. Then he looked at Zoro's lunch box. Zoro was asleep. Luffy {1} to take just one piece of meat. But one piece became two, and two became five. Soon the box was empty! When Zoro woke up, he was very angry. Luffy {2} bad. "I'm sorry! I will {3} you back!" he said. But Luffy had no money. So he went fishing all afternoon. He caught a huge fish and gave it to Sanji. That night, Sanji cooked a fish dinner for everyone. Zoro {4} it so much that he forgot he was angry. Luffy smiled and asked, "Then can I have your fish too?" Zoro did not {5} answer. He just ate faster.

blanks.why: plan to + 原形動詞「打算做…」：魯夫打算只拿一塊肉。felt to、paid to、reported to take 都不對。
feel bad「覺得過意不去」。paid、saved、planned bad 都不通。
pay + 人 + back「還某人、補償某人」。feel、enjoy、become you back 都不通。
enjoy + 食物「吃得很開心」：索隆吃得太開心，忘了自己在生氣。paid、saved、moved it 都不通。
not even「連…都不」：索隆連回答都沒有。ago、away、than 都不能放在 did not 和動詞中間。

passages.zh: 魯夫最愛吃肉了。有一天，香吉士為船上每個人做了一個大便當。魯夫一分鐘就吃完了自己的，然後看向索隆的便當。索隆正在睡覺，魯夫打算只拿一塊肉。結果一塊變兩塊，兩塊變五塊，很快便當就空了！索隆醒來後非常生氣。魯夫覺得很過意不去：「對不起！我會補償你的！」可是魯夫沒有錢，於是他釣了一整個下午的魚，釣到一條超大的魚交給香吉士。那天晚上，香吉士為大家煮了一頓魚大餐。索隆吃得太開心，忘了自己在生氣。魯夫笑著問：「那我可以也吃你的魚嗎？」索隆連回答都沒有，只是吃得更快了。
